players.product: Data-center cooling (Airedale chillers/CRAHs, liquid cooling) — pure-play after PT spin

quarterly_data.signal: Modine's 10-Q: Data Centers segment operating income was $46.3 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus $34.7 million a year earlier. Data Centers cost of sales rose $149.3 million, or 116 percent, on higher sales volume, approximately $16.0 million of higher material costs, expenses of the rapid U.S. manufacturing capacity expansion, and supplier capacity constraints for certain key components that temporarily disrupted production schedules; Modine is working with current partners and qualifying additional suppliers to secure supply. Data Centers capital expenditures were $30.9 million versus $7.1 million, driven by investments to increase production capacity.
